Entry filters and exit parameters were selected on each window's TRAINING data and then applied unchanged to the unseen TEST window; risk rules are fixed (untuned) portfolio-level policies replayed over the test windows. Entry filters only remove baseline entries. Trade-level tables use a fixed ₹100,000 notional per trade; portfolio tables start each window at ₹5,000 and chain across windows. Rejected enhancements are preserved with reasons.
